title.narrative: Strengthening Fiscal Management and Sustainability Program (Subprogram 1)

description.narrative: A series of exogenous shocks severely affected public finance, poverty, and macroeconomy. Public expenditure increased drastically to support social protection scheme, but revenue mobilization decreased in line with the decline in tourist arrivals and a general economic downturn, leading to deterioration of fiscal and debt situation. The proposed program supports the government's structural reforms to strengthen fiscal consolidation focusing on domestic resource mobilization, and expenditure and debt management. It is aligned to the government's medium-term fiscal and debt management strategies, and the Asian Development Bank's (ADB) country partnership strategy for Maldives 2020-2024. It will contribute to the following operational priorities of Strategy 2030: (i) addressing remaining poverty and reducing inequality; (ii) gender equality and women's empowerment; (iii) tackling climate change, building climate and disaster resilience, and enhancing environmental sustainability; and (iv) strengthening governance and institutional capacity.

title.narrative: Policy 1 Outcome 1 Implementation Period: Apr 01, 2021 - Aug 31, 2023

description.narrative:
Action 1: (i) The Parliament passed on 16 November 2022 amendments to GST Act effective 1 January 2023 to enhance revenue mobilization by increasing rates for tourism GST and general GST, and (ii) MIRA approved GST regulation on 27 November 2022 to implement the amended GST Act. Target date: 2023-08-31
Action 2: (i) The Parliament passed on 5 July 2021 amendments to the Airport Taxes and Fees Act with an increase in AF and introduction of a departure tax, and (ii) MIRA approved on 29 September 2021 Airport Taxes and Fees Regulation to implement the amended Act effective 1 January 2022. Target date: 2023-08-31
Action 3: MIRA approved on 21 September 2022 the Green Tax Regulation effective 1 January 2023 to increase revenue by (i) widening coverage by including integrated tourist resorts, resort hotels, hotels, and other similar tourist establishment under the green tax; and (ii) increasing rate levied on guesthouses with more than 50 registered rooms and guesthouses in uninhabited islands from $3 per day to $6 per day per guest. Target date: 2023-08-31
Action 4: The Parliament on 28 November 2022 passed the Waste Management Bill, which imposes a levy of $0.13 tax on a plastic bag, to boost revenue and to phase out single-use plastics to reduce environment pollution. Target date: 2023-08-31

title.narrative: Policy 2 Outcome 1 Implementation Period: Apr 01, 2021 - Aug 31, 2023

description.narrative:
Policy 2: Bolstering expenditure and debt management NA
Action 2: MOF (i) approved Sustainable Financing Framework (SFF) to promote green finance and sustainable investment in June 2023, and (ii) upgraded and started operationalizing debt recording and management system to enhance debt operations and management in line with the medium-term debt management strategy 2023-2025. Target date: 2023-08-31
Action 3: The Parliament passed (i) Climate Emergency Act in April 2021 provisioning a new legal structure and guidelines for addressing issues related to climate change and to achieve the target of net zero emissions by 2030 as per its nationally determined contributions in line with the Paris Agreement, and (ii) Maldives Energy Act in October 2021 mandating the government to determine specific 5-year goals for electricity generated from renewable energy sources and facilitating and prioritization of adoption of renewable energy sources. Target date: 2023-08-31
Action 4: The Cabinet approved the National Gender Equality Action Plan 2022-2026 effective February 2022 and commenced its implementation with (i) the establishment of a high-level steering committee chaired by the President, (ii) the approval of Maldives Gender Equality Model in November 2022, and (iii) the issuance of a policy directive on 31 May 2022 to pilot adoption of GRB. Target date: 2023-08-31
Action 5: The Cabinet approved a policy directive on 11 April 2022 regarding Aasandha scheme to implement bulk procurement of key Aasandha medicine and medical consumables to rationalize health care subsidies and spending. Target date: 2023-08-31
Action 6: The government (i) established a functional State Shareholding Management Department within MOF effective 18 September 2022 to improve management of fiscal risks and debt incurred by SOEs, and (ii) approved and started implementation of procurement procedures and guidelines for SOEs to standardize procurement practices across all SOEs. Target date: 2023-08-31
